title: 第66章 烹食猿兽肉 破境升后期第65章 一路辞浓雾 涧边战猿兽
lines: 正午的阳光洒落青岩溪涧，暖融融的光线穿透枝叶缝隙，点点光斑落在覆着薄冰的青石之上，细碎冰粒映着日光泛出粼粼微光。
方才打斗卷起的落叶碎石散落在溪岸两侧，溪岩青纹猿冰封的身躯静立原地，寒气渐渐被日光消融，表层冰层微微化开些许水汽。涧水顺着岩缝潺潺流动，叮咚水声冲淡了厮杀残留的戾气，山林间恢复平和。
罗止正倚着一旁岩壁站定，小腿被岩刺扎破的伤口还隐隐作痛，裤角沾着淡色血渍。他微微屈膝试探伤势，眉头轻蹙，动作不敢幅度太大。
随峰收拢羽翼落至脚边，羽翼间仍带着几分滞涩，内伤未愈，呼吸略显粗重，只是紧绷的神态稍稍放松，不时抬首环顾四周，警戒暗处潜藏的动静。
李紫云缓步走到罗止正身旁，目光紧紧落在他渗血的小腿伤口上，眉眼间带着几分担忧，轻声问道：“腿上伤口怎么样了？痛感还强烈吗？”
罗止正抬手轻按伤口周边，缓缓活动了一下腿脚，神色从容淡然：“算不上重伤，只是被岩刺划破皮肉，走动时会扯着疼，歇息一阵便能缓过来。”
罗止正抬眸细细打量她的模样，看清开裂淌血的虎口，也察觉到她气息虚浮，语气满是关切：“方才你撑盾硬挡碎石，冰盾崩碎受了内伤，虎口也震裂出血，身子还扛得住吗？”
李紫云垂眸瞥了眼淌血的掌心，抬手简单压住伤口，神色强作安稳，缓缓摇头：“只是内伤淤气、皮肉小伤，颈间灵玉链一直在调和气血，并无大碍。”
李紫云侧头望向一旁喘息休憩的随峰，眉眼添了几分顾虑，语声轻缓：“倒是随峰接连出爪、施展啸技，反震伤了内腑，羽翼挥动都不利索，得多多调息静养。”
说罢，李紫云抬手探向腰间储物袋，从中取出两株银纹紫心草，迈步走到一块平整青石边，屈膝缓缓蹲下身，将两株灵草平铺搁在青石面上，另一只手摸出腰间灵匕，五指握紧匕柄，垂眸反复用匕柄碾捣研磨，直至整株草药彻底碎裂，糅合渗出的汁水揉成稠厚细腻的药泥。
银纹紫心草可止血消肿、收敛伤口、消去淤青，还能疏通淤塞经脉，打散积滞气血；药性温和，外敷医治皮肉伤，内服亦可舒经活络。
李紫云掌心轻轻捧起青石上的药泥，缓步走到罗止正身前，顺势屈膝蹲下身，小心翼翼将微凉的药泥均匀敷在罗止正小腿的伤口处。
待伤口敷妥，余下的药泥尽数抹在自己开裂渗血的虎口之上，轻轻按压贴合妥当。
不过片刻，银纹紫心草的药力缓缓渗入皮肉，伤口刺痛慢慢消减，发胀感褪去不少。
罗止正缓步行至溪岩青纹猿的尸体旁，抬手抽出腰间骨刀，俯身着手解剖猿兽躯体。
李紫云又从腰间储物袋中取出两株清涧凝络花，抬手送一株入唇嚼碎咽下。余下一株伸手递向一旁的随峰，随峰微微探出脑袋，张口接住灵花，径直吞咽入腹。
清涧凝络花药力绵长温润，药力顺着周身脉络缓缓游走，可平复翻涌气血、理顺错乱经络，散去内伤淤积的滞气，缓缓补足大战耗损的灵力，润物细无声地滋养身躯、固本培元，对内腑震伤、气脉不稳效用极佳，药性柔和，不会伤及肌理。
李紫云寻了处干爽石地就地盘膝坐定，闭目凝神，引着药力游走周身经脉静心调息。一旁的随峰也趴卧在地，收拢双翼闭眼休憩，借着灵花药力慢慢平复内腑伤势。
罗止正握紧手中骨刀，顺着猿兽身躯轮廓下刀，仔细剃去表层皮毛，完整剥下兽皮，平铺搁在一旁洁净的石地上。
紧跟着刀刃探入肌理，扯出柔韧结实的兽筋，一并摆放妥当。而后刀锋贴着骨骼细细剔割，将整块兽肉从骨架上剥离下来，逐一分割成大小均匀的肉块，整齐堆放在青石旁。
罗止正将溪岩青纹猿的躯体尽数处理妥当，抬眼望向一侧，见李紫云与随峰仍旧闭目盘膝调息，不愿出声打搅他们。
他独自转身走向溪涧周边，捡拾散落的枯枝与干透木柴，边走边留意周遭环境。一路顺着溪岸往前走，行至溪水侧边时，瞧见溪涧两岸丛生着大片竹丛。竹竿泛着青灰岩色，竹节高高隆起如同硬朗背脊，表层爬满细密岩纹，质地紧实厚重，硬度堪比熟铁，普通刀剑很难劈砍破开；竹叶呈青碧之色，叶面凝着一层淡淡的水光，根系扎在溪畔湿软的岩土缝隙里，一丛丛簇拥生长。
这正是铁脊青岩竹，凡级三阶灵植。
罗止正将手里捡拾的干柴枯枝轻轻搁在岸边空地，缓步朝着成片竹丛走去。他抬手抚上竹竿表层，指尖摩挲着凸起的竹节与细密岩纹，切身触感沉甸甸冷硬，细细感受着竹身紧实坚硬的质地。
他目光细细扫过整片竹丛，最终选中一根粗细匀称、高度合适的竹株，尺寸方正趁手，刚好可用来做枪杆。随后抽出腰间骨刀，凝神蓄力，右臂发力朝着竹身猛力劈下。
铛！
清亮刺耳的金属碰撞声骤然响起。
锋利的骨刀落于竹身之上，仅浅浅蹭出一道极浅的白痕，根本无法劈入分毫。
罗止正瞬间感知到铁脊青岩竹的骇人硬度，虎口骤然剧烈发麻，一股强劲的反震之力顺着小臂直冲而上，整条手臂筋骨酸胀发麻。
罗止正稳住身形，稍作调息压下手臂酸胀，避开厚实竹节，找准竹身缝隙偏软处，再度挥刀接连劈砍。几番发力之下，竹竿终于从中断裂，直直倾倒落地。
他弯腰拾起截下的竹竿，低头看向掌心的骨刀，刀沿多处豁口崩裂，刃口凹凸不齐，几番硬劈铁脊青岩竹，已然将这柄骨刀砍出不少缺口。
他再度握紧这把残破骨刀，一点点削去竹竿旁侧丛生的竹枝。刀刃虽说破损严重，削斩细枝尚且够用，不多时便将多余枝杈尽数剔除干净，只留笔直竿身。
望着刃口处处崩口的骨刀，罗止正心中略有些不舍，可这刀具彻底失去劈砍的作用，没法继续使用。他抬手将骨刀丢进一旁的草丛。
他细细打量手中的灵竹，抬首望向整片茂密竹丛，心中已然打定主意，往后便称这竹子为“铁脊青岩竹”。
说完，他折返岸边空地，拾起先前搁下的干柴枯枝，右手握着竹竿，左手抱着柴薪，顺着来路往回走去。
罗止正攥紧铁脊青岩竹竿，怀里搂牢收拢好的干柴，脚步不疾不徐顺着溪岸原路折返。小腿伤口外敷的药泥牢牢贴在皮肉之上，走动时拉扯产生的钝痛已然大幅减轻，并未耽搁赶路。
等他回到方才休整的青石空地时，恰好撞见李紫云缓缓睁开双眼，长长吐出一口郁结浊气，周身紊乱的灵力彻底归位；一旁趴伏在地的随峰也同步抬起脑袋，舒展收拢已久的双翼，羽翼滞涩感消散大半，粗重的呼吸变得平稳绵长，一人一宠刚好调息完毕。
罗止正停下脚步，目光细细扫过两人气色，神色放松不少，轻声说道：“看你们气色舒缓不少，内伤应当稳住了。”
李紫云轻轻转动手腕活动筋骨，瞥见虎口药泥干结、创口不再渗血，视线牢牢锁定那根异样竹竿，眉眼间满是探究，开口问道：“你方才独自前去捡拾木柴，还寻来了这根竹杆？瞧着质地绝非寻常竹木。”
罗止正单手托起竹竿掂量分量，指腹反复摩挲坚硬凸起的竹节，神色笃定地解释：“这是我方才在溪畔竹丛找到的灵植，我定名它为‘铁脊青岩竹’，硬度堪比熟铁。原本打算捡拾柴火，偶然撞见这片竹丛，想着苍纹陨铁枪遗失，便截取一根打算改做新枪杆。”

The midday sun shines on the Qingyan Stream, and the warm light penetrates through the gaps between the branches and leaves. Dots of light fall on the bluestones covered with thin ice, and the fine ice particles reflect the sunlight and give off a shimmering light.
The fallen leaves and gravel rolled up by the fight just now are scattered on both sides of the stream bank. The frozen body of the Xiyan Blue-striped Ape stands still. The cold air is gradually melted by the sunlight, and some water vapor is slightly melted in the surface ice. The stream gurgled along the cracks in the rocks. The sound of the water diluted the remaining violence of the fighting, and peace returned to the mountains and forests.
Luo Zhi was standing leaning against the rock wall. The wound on his calf punctured by the rock thorn was still painful, and the corners of his trousers were stained with light blood. He bent his knees slightly to test the injury, frowned slightly, and did not dare to move too much.
Sui Feng folded his wings and fell to his feet. There was still a bit of sluggishness between the wings, and the internal injuries had not healed. His breathing was a little heavy, but his tense expression relaxed slightly. From time to time, he raised his head and looked around, alert to the movements lurking in the dark.
Li Ziyun walked slowly to Luo Zhizheng's side, his eyes focused on his bleeding calf wound, and with a bit of worry in his eyebrows, he asked softly: "How is the wound on the leg? Is the pain still strong?"
Luo Zhizheng raised his hand and pressed lightly around the wound, slowly moved his legs and feet, and said calmly and calmly: "It's not a serious injury, it's just the flesh that was scratched by the rock thorns. It will hurt when you walk around. It will ease after a while."
Luo Zhizheng raised his eyes to look at her carefully and saw the cracked and bleeding tiger's mouth. He also noticed that her breath was weak, and his tone was full of concern: "Just now you held up your shield to block the gravel. The ice shield shattered and you suffered internal injuries. The tiger's mouth was also cracked and bleeding. Can you still bear it?"
Li Ziyun lowered his eyes and glanced at the bleeding palm. He raised his hand to simply press the wound. He forced himself to look calm and shook his head slowly: "It's just internal bruises and small wounds on the skin and flesh. The jade chain around his neck has been reconciling the qi and blood, so it's nothing serious."
Li Ziyun turned his head and looked at Sui Feng, who was taking a breather. His eyebrows were a little worried, and his voice was soft: "On the contrary, Sui Feng used his claws one after another and performed his roaring skills. The backlash hurt his internal organs, and the wings were not flapping. I need to adjust my breath and rest more."
After saying that, Li Ziyun raised his hand and reached into the storage bag on his waist, took out two silver-grained purple heart grasses, walked to a flat bluestone, bent his knees and slowly squatted down, and laid the two spiritual grasses flat on the bluestone. With his other hand, he took out the spiritual dagger from his waist, grasped the dagger handle with five fingers, lowered his eyes and repeatedly crushed and ground the dagger handle until the whole herb was completely broken, and kneaded the oozing juice into a thick and fine medicinal mud.
Purple Heart Grass can stop bleeding, reduce swelling, astringe wounds, and eliminate bruises. It can also clear blocked meridians and disperse stagnant Qi and blood. It has mild medicinal properties and can be applied externally to treat skin injuries. Oral administration can also relax meridians and activate collaterals.
Li Ziyun gently picked up the medicinal mud on the bluestone with his palm, walked slowly in front of Luo Zhizheng, squatted down with his knees bent, and carefully applied the cool medicinal mud evenly on the wound on Luo Zhizheng's calf.
After the wound is properly applied, apply all the remaining mud on the cracked and bleeding tiger's mouth, and gently press it until it fits properly.
Within a moment, the medicinal power of silver-striped purple heart grass slowly penetrated into the skin and flesh, the stinging pain of the wound slowly subsided, and the feeling of swelling subsided a lot.
Luo Zhi was walking slowly to the body of the Xiyan Blue-striped Ape. He raised his hand and took out the bone knife from his waist, and leaned over to dissect the ape's body.
Li Ziyun took out two more Qingjian Ningluo flowers from the storage bag on his waist, raised his hand and put one into his lips, chewed it and swallowed it. The remaining one reached out and handed it to Sui Feng, who stuck his head out slightly, opened his mouth to catch the spirit flower, and swallowed it straight into his stomach.
The medicinal power of Qingjian Ningluo Flower is long-lasting and moist, and the medicinal power slowly travels along the veins of the whole body. It can calm the surging Qi and blood, straighten out the disordered meridians, disperse the stagnant Qi accumulated in internal injuries, slowly replenish the spiritual power lost in the war, moisturize the body silently, strengthen the body and strengthen the vitality. It is very effective in treating internal organ shocks and unstable Qi and pulses. The medicinal properties are gentle and will not damage the skin texture.
Li Ziyun found a dry stone place and sat cross-legged on the spot. He closed his eyes and concentrated, guiding the power of the medicine to circulate through the meridians throughout his body and calmly regulate his breathing. Sui Feng, who was beside him, also lay on the ground, folded his wings and closed his eyes to rest, using the power of the spirit flower medicine to slowly heal his internal injuries.
Luo Zhi was holding the bone knife in his hand tightly, following the outline of the ape's body, carefully shaving off the surface fur, peeling off the animal's skin completely, and laying it flat on the clean stone ground aside.
Then the blade penetrated into the texture, pulled out the flexible and strong animal sinews, and placed them properly. Then the blade of the blade was carefully cut against the bones, peeling off the entire piece of animal meat from the skeleton, dividing it into evenly sized pieces one by one, and stacking them neatly next to the bluestone.
Luo Zhi was finishing all the Xiyan Blue-striped Ape's body. He raised his eyes and looked to one side, and saw that Li Ziyun and Sui Feng were still adjusting their breaths with their eyes closed and crossed their legs, unwilling to disturb them.
He turned around and walked toward the stream alone, picking up scattered dead branches and dried firewood, paying attention to his surroundings as he walked. I walked along the stream bank all the way, and when I reached the side of the stream, I saw large bushes of bamboo growing on both sides of the stream. The bamboo poles are greenish-gray in color, and the bamboo joints are as high as a strong back. The surface is covered with fine rock patterns. The texture is tight and thick, and its hardness is comparable to wrought iron. It is difficult to cut and break with ordinary swords. The bamboo leaves are green in color, with a light layer of water on the leaves. The roots are embedded in the cracks of the soft rock and soil by the stream, growing in clusters.
This is the iron-spine green rock bamboo, a third-level ordinary spiritual plant.
Luo Zhizheng gently placed the dry firewood and dead branches he had picked up in the open space on the shore, and walked slowly towards the bamboo bushes. He raised his hand to touch the surface of the bamboo pole, his fingertips caressing the raised bamboo joints and fine rock patterns. It felt heavy and cold to the touch, and he could feel the tight and hard texture of the bamboo body.
He scanned the entire bamboo bush carefully, and finally selected a bamboo plant with a well-proportioned thickness and a suitable height. It was of a convenient size and could be used as a gun shaft. Then he drew out the bone knife from his waist, concentrated on accumulating strength, and used his right arm to strike hard at the bamboo body.
clang!
The clear and harsh sound of metal collision suddenly sounded.
The sharp bone knife fell on the bamboo body, leaving only a very shallow white mark, unable to cut into it at all.
Luo Zhizheng instantly felt the astonishing hardness of the iron-spine green rock bamboo, and his mouth suddenly became numb. A strong force of shock rushed straight up his forearm, and the muscles of his entire arm were sore and numb.
Luo Zhi stabilized his body, adjusted his breathing slightly to suppress the swelling in his arms, avoided the thick bamboo joints, found the soft spots in the bamboo body, and slashed with the knife again. After several attempts, the bamboo pole finally broke and fell straight to the ground.
He bent down to pick up the cut bamboo pole and looked down at the bone knife in the palm of his hand. The edge of the knife was cracked in many places and the blade was uneven. After several hard cuts of the iron-spine green rock bamboo, the bone knife had already cut many gaps.
He grasped the broken bone knife again and chipped away at the thick bamboo branches on the side of the bamboo pole. Although the blade of the knife was seriously damaged, it was still enough for cutting thin branches. After a while, all the excess branches were removed, leaving only the straight shaft.
Looking at the bone knife with its blade chipped everywhere, Luo Zhizheng felt a little reluctant, but the knife had completely lost its cutting function and could no longer be used. He raised his hand and threw the bone knife into the grass aside.
He carefully looked at the spiritual bamboo in his hand and looked up at the entire dense bamboo bush. He had already made up his mind and would call this bamboo "Iron-ridged Blue Rock Bamboo" from now on.
After saying that, he turned back to the open space on the shore, picked up the dry firewood and dead branches that he had put down earlier, held the bamboo pole in his right hand, and held the firewood in his left hand, and walked back along the way he came.
Luo Zhi was clutching the iron-backed green rock bamboo pole, holding the gathered dry firewood tightly in his arms, and retracing his steps along the stream bank without haste. The medicinal mud applied externally to the calf wound was firmly attached to the skin, and the dull pain caused by pulling when walking was greatly reduced, without delaying the journey.
When he returned to the bluestone clearing where he had just rested, he happened to see Li Ziyun slowly opening his eyes, exhaling a long breath of sluggish air, and the chaotic spiritual energy around him completely returned to his original position; Sui Feng, who was lying on the ground beside him, also raised his head at the same time, stretching his long-folded wings.
Luo Zhizheng stopped and glanced at the two people's expressions carefully. His expressions were much relaxed and he said softly: "Seeing that your expressions have relaxed a lot, the internal injuries should be stabilized."
Li Ziyun gently turned his wrist to move his muscles, and saw that the tiger's mouth medicine mud had dried up and the wound was no longer bleeding. His eyes were firmly fixed on the strange bamboo pole, and his eyebrows were full of inquiry, and he asked: "You just went to collect firewood alone and found this bamboo pole? The texture is definitely not ordinary bamboo."
Luo Zhizheng held up the bamboo pole with one hand and weighed it. He repeatedly rubbed the hard and convex bamboo joints with his fingertips and explained with determination: "This is the spiritual plant I just found in the bamboo bush by the stream. I named it 'Iron Ridge Blue Rock Bamboo'. It is as hard as wrought iron. I was planning to pick up firewood, but I accidentally bumped into this bamboo bush. Thinking that the Cangwen Iron Gun was missing, I cut one and planned to make it into a new gun shaft."
